Method of Attack: Exploitation of zero-day vulnerability in Windows Win32k kernel driver (CVE-2021-40449) for privilege escalation
Deployment of remote access trojan (RAT) to collect and exfiltrate system information
Spawning and killing processes, launching interactive shells, launching proxy server with up to 50 simultaneous connections
Impacted Systems: Windows client and server versions from Windows 7 and Windows Server 2008 to Windows 11 and Windows Server 2022
Attack Vector: Zero-day exploit targeting Win32k driver security flaw (CVE-2021-40449)
